QUICK WINS's prize table still has 382,323 free ticket wins unclaimed. That means more wins are left than it may seem. Near the top, the $50 prize has 6,278 left. Every prize level is counted below.

Every line of QUICK WINS's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1919.headline: What's actually left to win

1921.body:
About a third of the tickets for "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" have been sold. The game is near the midpoint of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1921.headline: Early stage or late

1927.body:
"CASH SCRATCH FEVER" just went on sale in Georgia. The game has fifteen full prize levels with three top prizes of $400,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

The numbers for "CASH SCRATCH FEVER" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1927.headline: New game, all prizes left

1929.body:
On "Cheers 2027", one $20,027 top prize was claimed three days ago. That leaves fifteen of the original seventeen. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Everything here about "Cheers 2027" comes from official Georgia lottery numbers, current through November 25.
1929.headline: Another top prize was claimed
